artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. His upper body is shown seated and facing slightly to the right. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a pronounced mustache, and a neatly groomed goatee. His light, wavy hair is combed back. He wears a period-appropriate outfit with a ruffled lace collar and a detailed doublet with buttons and embroidery. In his right hand, he holds a staff or baton, and there is a book near his left arm. The background features an oval with text around the man's bust and intricate scrollwork, including a coat of arms and Latin inscriptions, in the border.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh

The background features an oval frame with an inscription identifying him and decorative elements like scrolls and an emblematic design. Text below the portrait provides additional context.

The man has a closely cropped beard and a mustache with a high forehead, short curly hair, and is wearing elaborate clothing, including an ornate jacket and a large, ruffled collar. He is adorned with a chain of office around his neck and is holding a baton or scepter in his right hand. Surrounding the portrait is an intricately designed border with heraldic symbols, and beneath the portrait, there is an inscription of text in an elegant calligraphic style. The background behind him is textured.

artworks.title: Captain John Smith
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of Captain John Smith in an elaborate engraving style. He is seen from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a mustache, full beard, straight nose, and strong jawline. His hair is wavy and relatively short. He is wearing period attire with a high lace collar and a buttoned doublet with puffed sleeves. He is holding the pommel of a sword in his right hand. The portrait is framed with text at the top, and a small globe rests above his head on a pedestal. Grid-like lines and illustrations of a soldier and a man on horseback are in the background, conveying themes of exploration and conquest.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Smith

The man has a distinguished facial expression, with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He has short hair beneath a tall, wide-brimmed hat that sits firmly on his head. He is dressed in an elaborate outfit typical of the early 17th century, featuring a richly fur-trimmed cloak and a ruffled lace collar. In his right hand, he is holding a rolled document, and there appears to be a map or document partially visible in his left hand. The background features intricate scrollwork framing the subject's head and shoulders, with ships and nautical imagery suggesting exploration or maritime context. Beneath the portrait is text describing the individual's titles and achievements, along with a decorative crest.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Smith

artworks.title: Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset
